checks.observation: Clicked the visible link; navigated in the same tab to /play/index.html and loaded the Starfall Salvage title.

checks.name: Ordinary controls
checks.observation: Z selected Story and launched the first briefing/room. Right moved away from the dock, X braked, Z changed A READY to A WAIT, and Enter opened the in-game pause menu.

checks.observation: M01 Bay 1/4 briefing showed CHECKPOINT SAVED. After playing and pausing for more than two seconds, ordinary page reload booted a fresh title with CONTINUE M01. Z restored the matching Freight Spine M01 Bay 1/4 H3 briefing; launching restored the dock entry position rather than the prior moved position.

checks.name: Console
checks.observation: No warnings or errors were returned for the game tab.

checks.name: HTTP asset delivery
checks.observation: All 26 served files matched the local canonical dist bytes. WASM was served as application/wasm.

checks.name: Browser Back
checks.observation: Back returned from the game to the landing page with the Play in Browser button.

checks.name: Desktop layout
checks.observation: At the default viewport, document clientWidth and scrollWidth both measured 1265 pixels. The Play button, download/manual links and controls legend were visible without clipping.

screenshots.caption: Fresh local site title offered Story and Arcade, without Continue.
Ordinary page reload returned to a fresh title with Continue M01.
Z confirmed Continue and restored the earned Freight Spine M01 Bay 1/4 H3 briefing.

scope: Integration smoke and earned room-entry checkpoint recovery on this exact local origin. No injected save, emulator snapshot, Restart toolbar or Saved states was used.
